# SignStudio

> SignStudio is a free browser-based utility for cleaning plain paper backgrounds from handwriting images and editing PDF documents.

## Canonical website
https://skabdulahmed8.github.io/SignStudio/

## Tools
- Image Background Cleaner: isolates handwriting or ink from plain paper and exports a transparent PNG. It is not a general-purpose photo cutout or AI object segmentation tool.
- PDF Filler: fills supported interactive PDF fields and adds text, dates, ticks, crosses or a photo to PDF pages. It does not create handwritten signatures or apply digital certificates.

## Privacy
- Selected files are processed locally in the browser.
- The application does not upload user files to a SignStudio processing server.
- The application does not use accounts, analytics, tracking, document history or persistent file storage.
- Users download results to their own devices.
